'''Cronal's laboratory''' was located deep in the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trailia]]. [[Cronal]] used the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] for his experiments on the native [[Trailian]]s, turning them into fierce [[Trailian sithspawn|warriors]]. The laboratory was guarded by Trailians and other animals, but was eventually discovered and attacked by a group of offworlders just as he was about to unleash an army of his creations onto the New Republic.
